options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: bearer_token
options.description: Authentication bearer token. Needed when doing an ADM service proxy call.

options.name: contenttypeminthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold to learn Content Type information. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: contenttypepercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold in percent to learn Content Type information. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: cookieconsistencyminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: cookieconsistencypercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular cookie pattern for learning engine to learn that cookie. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: creditcardnumberminthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold to learn Credit Card information. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: creditcardnumberpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold in percent to learn Credit Card information. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: crosssitescriptingautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed. Minimum value = C(5) Maximum value = C(43200)

options.name: crosssitescriptingminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn HTML scripting patterns. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: crosssitescriptingpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular cross-site pattern for the learning engine to learn that cross-site scripting pattern. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: csrftagminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn request forgery (CSRF) tags. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: csrftagpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular CSRF tag for the engine to learn that CSRF tag. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: fieldconsistencyminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn field information. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: fieldconsistencypercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular field consistency for the learning engine to learn that field consistency pattern. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: fieldformatautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed. Minimum value = C(5) Maximum value = C(43200)

options.name: fieldformatminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn field Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: fieldformatpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular web form field for the learning engine to recommend a field format for that form field. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The id of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Citrix ADC instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(mas_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: When performing a Proxy API call with ADM service set this to C(true)

options.name: mas_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a Citrix ADM node to the target Citrix ADC instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token) When true and adm service is the api proxy the following option must also be defined: I(bearer_token) When true you must define a target ADC by defining any of the following parameters I(instance_ip) I(instance_id) I(instance_name)

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Citrix ADC

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the Citrix ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: profilename
options.description: Name of the profile. Minimum length =  1

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sqlinjectionautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed. Minimum value = C(5) Maximum value = C(43200)

options.name: sqlinjectionminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn HTML injection patterns. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: sqlinjectionpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular HTML SQL injection for the learning engine to learn that HTML SQL injection pattern. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: starturlminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn start Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: starturlpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular start URL pattern the learning engine to learn that start URL. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the Citrix ADC node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: xmlattachmentminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn XML patterns. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: xmlattachmentpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular XML attachment for the learning engine to learn that XML attachment pattern. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: xmlwsiminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn web interoperability (WSI) information. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: xmlwsipercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular pattern for the engine to learn a web services interoperability (WSI) pattern. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(100)
